name: Geometric Series Convergence Disguise
description: Replaces the original trigonometric condition for $h_u \neq h_v$ with a condition requiring that at least one of two infinite geometric series (using the ratios of the multipliers) converges. This forces the model to evaluate the convergence criteria for a geometric series (ratio strictly less than 1) to deduce that the variables must be unequal, bypassing simple pattern matching to graph 3-coloring.
